title: Analysis of Superradiance-Based Quantum Metrology under Independent Markovian Pure Dephasing
summary: Recently, a DC magnetometry protocol utilizing $N$-spin-ensemble superradiance was proposed. This method physically amplifies the acquired signal, suppressing estimation errors from measurement noise and achieving $\mathcal{O}(1/N)$ precision scaling when measurement noise dominates quantum fluctuations. However, quantum metrology is generally vulnerable to independent Markovian pure dephasing.
